en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with historic multi‑story buildings, shop signs and pedestrians with a cart in the foreground. At the end of the street rise two tall church towers. The caption at the top lists the city name in several languages and identifies the street. The reverse has typical postcard dividing lines and the Hungarian phrase 'LEVELEZŐ-LAP'.
